Bethpage Introductory Ride (CLIMB)

Old Bethpage, NY · Mountain bike

Bethpage Introductory Ride (CLIMB) is a mountain bike group ride in Old Bethpage, NY. It rolls first Sunday of the month at 8:45 am from Bethpage State Park playground.

Next ride Sun, Oct 4, 8:45 AM EDT

How we know

CLIMB's Meetup group lists a Bethpage Introductory Ride at 8:45 am on the first Sunday of each month, Jun 7 through Sep 6, 2026, and the next one on Sun Oct 4, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026).

Last seen happening Sep 6, 2026.

For visitors

The Meetup title calls it an introductory ride. The public list gives no pace or distance, so ask the group before you go.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:45 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bethpage Introductory Ride (CLIMB) group ride

CLIMB's monthly introductory mountain bike ride at Bethpage State Park, on the first Sunday of the month. The group runs trail work and rides across Long Island and has more than 800 members on Meetup.
